objective: Add temperature sensors, battery module, network speed tray text, and top 5 processes to close the competitive gap with iStat Menus and Stats while preserving PulseBar's lightweight identity.

phases.name: Temperature Sensors
phases.description: Add CPU, GPU, and SSD temperature monitoring to the dashboard panel and optional menu bar tray item

tasks.description: Initialize Components in metrics thread, refresh each tick, extract CPU/GPU/SSD temps

tasks.task: Add temperature fields to Metrics struct
tasks.description: Add cpu_temp_c: Option<f32>, gpu_temp_c: Option<f32>, ssd_temp_c: Option<f32> to Metrics
Map macOS sensor names (SOC MTR Temp Sensor0, GPU MTR Temp Sensor0, etc.) to cpu/gpu/ssd categories. Handle Intel vs Apple Silicon naming differences.
tasks.notes: Sensor names vary by hardware. Need testing on multiple Mac models or robust fuzzy matching.

tasks.description: New colored tray item: TMP 52° in warm red (#FF6B6B). Visible only in full mode.
Add temperature display section to the WebView panel with CPU/GPU/SSD temps and optional sparklines

tasks.task: Add temperature bar to live icon
tasks.description: Evaluate whether to add a 5th bar to the animated icon for temperature, or keep it at 4 bars. Decision point — may skip to keep icon clean.
Verify temperature readings match Activity Monitor / TG Pro on M1/M2/M3/M4

phases.name: Battery Module
phases.description: Add battery percentage, health, cycle count, and charging state to dashboard and optional tray item

tasks.description: Parse 'ioreg -r -c AppleSmartBattery' output for CurrentCapacity, MaxCapacity, DesignCapacity, CycleCount, IsCharging, ExternalConnected, TimeRemaining
tasks.notes: Follows same pattern as existing GPU ioreg parsing

tasks.task: Battery thread or integrate into metrics thread
tasks.description: Battery changes slowly — poll every 30s instead of every tick. Either separate thread or conditional refresh in main metrics loop.

tasks.task: Add battery fields to Metrics struct
tasks.description: battery_percent: Option<u32>, battery_health: Option<u32>, battery_cycles: Option<u32>, battery_charging: Option<bool>, battery_time_remaining_min: Option<i32>
New colored tray item: BAT 87% in amber (#FFB800). Auto-hidden on desktops (no battery detected). Visible in standard and full modes.
Battery section in WebView panel: percentage ring/bar, health indicator, cycle count, charging state icon, time remaining
Ensure battery section and tray item are completely hidden when no battery is detected (iMac, Mac Mini, Mac Pro, Mac Studio)
Test: charging, discharging, full, TimeRemaining=-1 (calculating), no battery present

phases.name: Network Speed Tray Text
phases.description: Add live network throughput as colored menu bar text with accurate rate calculation

tasks.description: Current code divides bytes-since-refresh by 1024 but does NOT divide by refresh interval. Fix: divide by (rate_ms / 1000.0) to get true KB/s. This is a bug fix that applies to v1.0.2 panel display as well.
Format network speed with auto-scaling: B/s, KB/s, MB/s, GB/s. Show one decimal for MB/s and above.
New colored tray item: NET ↓2.3 ↑0.1 MB/s in teal/cyan (#00BCD4). Visible in full mode.
After system wake, first refresh may report accumulated bytes during sleep as a single-tick burst. Clamp to 10 GB/s max to filter impossible spikes.
Add net: NativeStatusItem to MetricTrays. Update creation order for correct left-to-right layout.
Verify network speed accuracy at 1s, 2s, and 5s refresh intervals against Activity Monitor

phases.name: Top 5 Processes
phases.description: Expand dashboard to show ranked list of top 5 CPU-consuming processes

tasks.description: Replace top_process_name: String + top_process_cpu: f32 with top_processes: Vec<ProcessInfo> where ProcessInfo { name: String, cpu: f32 }. Cap at 5 entries.
Sort processes by CPU usage descending, take top 5. Already iterating all processes — just need to collect more.
Map common macOS process names to friendly names: kernel_task -> macOS Kernel, WindowServer -> Window Server, mds_stores -> Spotlight, bird -> iCloud Sync, etc.
Replace single top process display with a 5-row mini table. Each row: rank number, process name (truncated 20 chars), CPU % with small inline bar.
Ensure the Metrics struct change (single process -> vec) doesn't break the existing frontend during development. Use serde flatten or provide both old and new fields temporarily.

phases.name: Integration and Release
phases.description: Final integration, testing, version bump, and release packaging

tasks.description: Update version in Cargo.toml, tauri.conf.json, lib.rs APP_VERSION, index.html, README.md
Ensure v1.0.2 settings.json loads cleanly in v1.1.0 with new fields defaulting gracefully. No breaking changes to Settings struct serialization.
Verify memory stays under 60MB, CPU under 1%, DMG under 15MB with all new features active
tasks.notes: Temperature polling adds sysinfo::Components refresh. Battery adds ioreg subprocess. Monitor impact.

tasks.description: Define which new metrics appear in each mode: minimal (CPU only), standard (CPU + RAM + BAT), full (all metrics including TMP + NET)
Write v1.1.0 release notes highlighting new features
Full release build pipeline

tasks.task: Update GitHub release and Gumroad listing
tasks.description: New DMG, updated screenshots, updated description
Capture new screenshots showing temperature, battery, network, and process list

dependencies.new_crates: None required — sysinfo::Components covers temperature, ioreg parsing covers battery (same pattern as GPU), network data already collected
dependencies.permissions: None — all APIs work without elevated privileges on macOS 12+
dependencies.apple_silicon: All features tested against Apple Silicon IOKit sensor names

risk_summary.highest_risk: Temperature sensor name mapping across different Mac models (1.3)
risk_summary.mitigation: Fuzzy matching on sensor names + fallback to showing raw names + community testing
risk_summary.overall_risk: LOW — all features use proven patterns already in the codebase
